overview_widgets: Net Worth Hero Card with monthly trend chart & asset allocation breakdown (Bank, Mutual Funds, Stocks, EPF/PPF, Gold).
Monthly Cash Flow Summary (Income vs Spend vs Savings Rate % gauge).
Recent Transactions table with category icons and quick filter pills.
Goal Progress Cards with projected target dates.

4_what_if_simulator_centerpiece.visual_priority: THE VISUAL CENTERPIECE OF THE ENTIRE APP. Prominent tab/page and hero widget.
interactive_controls: Scenario Selector: 'Career Hike (e.g., +20% Salary)', 'Buy Property (₹75L Loan)', 'Boost SIP (+₹10k/mo)', 'Early Retirement at 45', 'Prepay Home Loan vs Invest'.
Dynamic Sliders: Monthly Income Change, One-time Expense/Lump sum, SIP Multiplier, Inflation Rate %, Expected Return %.
Indian Specific Parameters: EPF contribution rate, Tax savings under 80C/80CCD(1B), Rent vs Buy calculator.
data_visualization: Dual-curve Projected Net Worth Comparison Chart (Baseline trajectory vs What-If trajectory over 5-30 years) using Recharts with mint (#00F5A0) and cyan (#00E5FF) neon gradients.
Impact Summary Cards: Net Worth Delta at Year 10 (e.g., +₹42.8 Lakhs), Retirement Age Difference (-3.5 Years), Financial Freedom Index.
4_what_if_simulator_centerpiece.ai_explanation_box: Structured AI Insights Box detailing 1) Recommendation ('Optimal Choice: Boost SIP'), 2) Risk & Liquidity Breakdown, 3) Tax Implications, 4) Actionable Step-by-Step Execution Plan.

accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Ensure white text (#F8FAFC) on #0F1420 has 12:1 contrast ratio. Secondary text (#94A3B8) on surface has >4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_ids: CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Every key interactive element MUST have explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as noisy full screen gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating navbars and modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Add targeted transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp rectangular with neon accent border & micro-animations).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 for primary interface icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, slider interactions, tab switching.
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for stable testing.
Format ALL monetary values with Indian Rupee symbol (₹) and Indian comma separator rules (e.g. ₹12,50,000 or ₹1.25 Cr).
The What-If Simulator MUST be built as the visual centerpiece with twin-curve scenario projections and structured AI decision rationale.
